title: New sort field aliases go in uiSortAliases or searchsort.ParseSortName, not inline
answers: Where do I add a new alternate sort name for dashboard search?
How to map a UI sort label to an index field?
body: UI-specific sort labels that don't match an index field name (e.g. `name_sort` -> title) are added to the `uiSortAliases` map in pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/search.go. Legacy `/api/search`-style sort names carrying direction as a suffix (e.g. `viewed-recently-desc`, `alpha-asc`) are handled by the shared `searchsort.ParseSortName` in pkg/services/search/sort, reused rather than reimplemented so both the old and new search endpoints stay consistent.
